summary: Comprehensive first-iteration testing of SPIKE (React Native Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass covering config, auth (login/register/me/captcha), job lifecycle (create → claim → book → on-way → arrive → before-photos → start → after-photos → complete → approve → payment released → review), atomic claim (409 on race), role guards (customer→claim 403, unauth /jobs 401), 24-hour address privacy (exact_address hidden from handyman, address_released=false for future job; released immediately for emergency), evidence enforcement (start blocked w/o before, complete blocked w/o after), off-platform chat flagging (cash/venmo), duplicate/pre-completion review rejection (400), disputes (job → DISPUTED), admin stats + user suspend + subsequent 403 on login. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login with prefilled jane@spike.app + math-captcha routes customer to /home showing greeting, 'Post a Job' hero, category chips scrolling, jobs list, tab bar + FAB. Post-Job wizard step 1 renders. Handyman mike routes to /available showing 3 jobs sorted by distance, ZIP masked as 921**, CLAIMABLE badges. Admin admin@spike.app routes to /admin showing stats (Users 9, Jobs 8, Open disputes 1, Revenue $40.00) and user list with per-user Suspend buttons. Registration completes and auto-signs in customer. No React Native red-screen errors. No deprecated Expo packages (uses useSafeAreaInsets, expo-linear-gradient, expo-router).

minor.issue: Urgency field only accepts 'standard' | 'emergency'. Problem-statement examples used 'normal' — main agent should either accept 'normal' as alias or document explicitly. Backend behaviour is consistent; only doc mismatch.

issues: Tab bar exposes 'post-job' as a routable tab alongside the FAB — duplicates entry point. Consider hiding via href:null in tabs.Screen options.

action_items: (Doc only) Clarify urgency values in problem statement — backend expects 'standard' | 'emergency', not 'normal'.
(Minor UX) Hide the tab entry for 'post-job' in customer tab bar (use href:null) to avoid duplicating the FAB/hero.
No functional bugs to fix — MVP is production-quality for end-to-end demo of the flows tested.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1382 lines — will become hard to maintain. Consider splitting into modules (auth, jobs, messages, admin, mocks) before next feature wave.
Job lifecycle transitions are correctly guarded (state, role, ownership). Atomic claim uses find_one_and_update — correct.
_mask_address correctly strips exact_address/customer_phone/customer_email for non-owners until release_at or emergency urgency.
MongoDB _id is stripped by projection {'_id': 0} or clean_doc — no ObjectId serialization issues observed.
Frontend uses testID consistently on all interactive components. Uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. StyleSheet.create used throughout.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed jobs (tv_mounting normal + emergency, cleaning dispute) and TEST_-prefixed throwaway users. Owner assets left in DB and are safely identifiable by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Login body MUST include captcha_token >= 6 chars (any string). Urgency values: 'standard' | 'emergency'. Full lifecycle happy-path requires: create job → handyman claim → customer book → on-way → arrive (GPS check lax in demo) → upload before → start → upload after → complete → customer approve → PAYMENT_RELEASED → review. Address protection: address_release_at = scheduled_start - 24h, released immediately for urgency=emergency. Handyman must be VERIFIED (mike/sarah/alex seeded VERIFIED). Reviews require CUSTOMER_APPROVED or PAYMENT_RELEASED. Off-platform detection triggers on cash/venmo/paypal/zelle/cashapp/etc.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
